title: Meditate 30 minutes per day.
subtitle: High practice volume
rationale: Hold a full program-level daily dose once shorter sits stop being a challenge.
tierTarget: 30 minutes of meditation on most days

evidence.summary: Dose-response evidence above 20 daily minutes is thin; longer practice matches formal program doses but incremental benefit is not well quantified.

sources.label: Meditation programs systematic review and meta-analysis

indications: 20 daily minutes are established and no longer difficult.
The practice is valuable enough to justify a bigger slot.
